requirements.sourceText: The minor requires seven courses totaling at least 22 credits as outlined below:

policies.sourceText: All courses above must be passed with a grade of C or higher

notes.text: To declare the minor, students must complete CSE 101 with a grade of B- or higher and possess a cumulative grade point average of 3.00 or higher. Students with transfer credit toward the required course must speak to the Undergraduate Program Director to determine the course needed for minor entry. Admission is competitive and contingent upon program capacity. The minor is open to students not majoring in Computer Science or Information Systems and not minoring in Computer Science.
Consult with the ISE Undergraduate Program Director on the suitability of an elective course prior to registration.
